# Casa Esmeralda Ridge

> Brand-new three-bedroom vacation rental with its own private waterfall pool, inside the gated Arenas community in Herradura, Garabito, Puntarenas, Costa Rica. Hosted by Pura Vida Sloth Escapes. About 5 minutes from Playa Herradura, near Jacó and Los Sueños.

## The home
- Entire home, brand new. Up to 6 guests. 3 bedrooms, 5 beds, 2 bathrooms.
- Bedroom 1: king bed. Bedroom 2: bunk bed. Bedroom 3: queen bed. Living room: sofa bed.
- Private pool with a stone waterfall and a lit living wall, gas grill, outdoor dining table for six, turf.
- Open-concept living room with a 65 inch TV, fully equipped kitchen, dedicated workspace, high-speed Wi-Fi.
- Washer and dryer (for stays of more than 2 nights). Free parking on the premises and an EV charger.
- Step-free living room entrance wider than 32 inches. Smoke alarm, carbon monoxide alarm, exterior security cameras.

## The Arenas community
- Gated, with 24-hour security.
- Two shared pool areas, a fully equipped gym, soccer field, basketball, tennis and volleyball courts, gazebos, walking trails, coworking areas, a kids' movie room, ping pong and foosball tables, a trampoline and playgrounds.

## Stay details
- Check-in after 12:00 PM. Check-out before 12:00 PM. Self check-in with a smart lock.
- Stays longer than a week: electricity is charged from the meter reading (about 90 colones per kWh for the first 200 kWh and 143 colones after) with a $200 refundable meter deposit.
- Prices are not published. Send your dates and Melina replies with your total.

## Hosts
- Melina, with co-hosts Kattia, Jason and Marlon. Melina speaks English, Spanish and Portuguese.
- Airbnb shows a 100% response rate and replies within an hour.

## Rating
- 5.0 out of 5 from 7 reviews on Airbnb, Guest favorite, Top 10% of homes (as of November 2026).
